crossRefs.note: Brothers, be imitators together of me, and note those who walk this way, even as you have us for an example.

Don’t count him as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.
Some men came down from Judea and taught the brothers, “Unless you are circumcised after the custom of Moses, you can’t…
Because we have heard that some who went out from us have troubled you with words, unsettling your souls, saying, ‘You…
Now I beg you, brothers, through the name of our Lord, Jesus Christ, that you all speak the same thing, and that there…
for you are still fleshly. For insofar as there is jealousy, strife, and factions among you, aren’t you fleshly, and…
For first of all, when you come together in the assembly, I hear that divisions exist among you, and I partly believe…
but there isn’t another “good news.” Only there are some who trouble you and want to pervert the Good News of Christ.
This was because of the false brothers secretly brought in, who stole in to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ…
Beware of the dogs; beware of the evil workers; beware of the false circumcision.
For we are the circumcision, who worship God in the Spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the…

But false prophets also arose among the people, as false teachers will also be among you, who will secretly bring in…
Many will follow their immoral ways, and as a result, the way of the truth will be maligned.
They went out from us, but they didn’t belong to us; for if they had belonged to us, they would have continued with us.…
For many deceivers have gone out into the world, those who don’t confess that Jesus Christ came in the flesh. This is…
These are those who cause divisions and are sensual, not having the Spirit.
“Woe to the world because of occasions of stumbling! For it must be that the occasions come, but woe to that person…

If he refuses to listen to them, tell it to the assembly. If he refuses to hear the assembly also, let him be to you as…

Now we command you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that you withdraw yourselves from every brother who…
If any man doesn’t obey our word in this letter, note that man, that you have no company with him, to the end that he…
If anyone teaches a different doctrine, and doesn’t consent to sound words, the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to…
holding a form of godliness, but having denied its power. Turn away from these, also.
Avoid a factious man after a first and second warning,
If anyone comes to you, and doesn’t bring this teaching, don’t receive him into your house, and don’t welcome him,
for he who welcomes him participates in his evil deeds.

translations.web: Now I beg you, brothers, look out for those who are causing the divisions and occasions of stumbling, contrary to the doctrine which you learned, and turn away from them.
translations.bsb: Now I urge you, brothers, to watch out for those who create divisions and obstacles that are contrary to the teaching you have learned. Turn away from them.
translations.kjv: Now I beseech you, brethren, mark them which cause divisions and offences contrary to the doctrine which ye have learned; and avoid them.
translations.asv: Now I beseech you, brethren, mark them that are causing the divisions and occasions of stumbling, contrary to the doctrine which ye learned: and turn away from them.
